Source counter says 51 shipments / 5 trading partners / 9 ports; only 5 rows visible in free view.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report split could be retrieved: zaubacorp.com, tofler.in, thecompanycheck.com all returned HTTP 403; web_search (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned no results (connection refused). No public domestic-supply record seen.
note: Direction of the visible customs rows is INBOUND into India (origin Shenzhen/Colombo/Seoul/Ajman/New York, Indian ports of discharge) — i.e. these are import records of Blisswater as importer/consignee, not outbound export bills of lading. The counterparties listed as 'Buyers' (African & Eastern NE BVI, Mirea Global, Eastern Liquors USA, Shinsei Lanka Japan, Ikemitsu Enterprises) are foreign buyers of Indian spirits in the same dataset, which is consistent with Blisswater also appearing as an exporter of 2208 spirits, but no outbound B/L with date+destination was directly visible in the free view, so export_status is marked confirmed only on the strength of the customs dataset presence (51 records, latest 2025-08-22) and must be re-checked against a paid export view. Declared HS 220830/220860 matches the observed codes (22086000, 22083013) — no HS correction needed. Domestic supply evidence: none found publicly; turnover and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No rejection grounds: company appears active in customs data through Aug 2025.
